tasks.title: Support compound Chinese numerals in temporal queries
tasks.instructions: Extend TemporalParser's Chinese numeral parsing to support compound values such as 二十, 二十一, and 三十五. Preserve existing single-character and Arabic numeral behavior, add deterministic cases to the existing temporal parser tests, and reject malformed numeral strings.

hidden_checks.description: Compound Chinese day and week expressions resolve to correct offsets.
hidden_checks.command: bun -e "import { TemporalParser } from './src/services/worker/search/TemporalParser.ts'; const p=new TemporalParser(); const now=new Date('2026-04-09T12:00:00Z'); const day=86400000; const a=p.parse('二十一天前',now); const b=p.parse('三十五天前',now); if(!a||!b||Math.round((now.getTime()-a.anchorDate.getTime())/day)!==21||Math.round((now.getTime()-b.anchorDate.getTime())/day)!==35) process.exit(1);"

hidden_checks.description: Existing English, Arabic, and single-character Chinese parsing remains intact.

tasks.title: Restore upward token estimation at fractional boundaries
tasks.instructions: A seeded regression changes observation token estimation from ceiling to floor rounding. Reproduce the failures, restore conservative upward rounding, and add or retain a focused assertion proving fractional token counts round up without changing exact-boundary behavior.

hidden_checks.description: Fractional estimates round upward rather than undercounting context.

tasks.title: Reject leaked nested-session identifiers during environment sanitization
tasks.instructions: Review the seeded environment-sanitizer change as a security defect. Ensure CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION is always removed from child-process environments while the OAuth token and SDK entrypoint remain allowed. Strengthen the existing sanitizer regression test so future allowlist or exact-deny edits cannot leak nested-session identifiers.

setup_operations.old_text:
'CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN',    // CLI subscription billing auth
  'CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT',     // Set to 'sdk-ts' by buildIsolatedEnv
setup_operations.new_text:
'CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN',    // CLI subscription billing auth
  'CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT',     // Set to 'sdk-ts' by buildIsolatedEnv
  'CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION',        // Preserve parent session context

hidden_checks.description: Nested-session identifiers are stripped while required SDK credentials survive.
The complete sanitizer test suite passes.
